claims.criterionText: A named script runs every suite under `tests/held-out/`, and it is reachable from the project gate so a red suite fails the build.
claims.reason: The charter's portal clause reaches a feature whose facts an insurance-portal route can produce. This criterion's fact is that a named npm script runs every suite under `tests/held-out/` and that the gate reaches it: a fact about this repository's own scripts and corpus, produced by running the corpus, with no page to read and no route that renders it. No insurance-portal route produces it, so the portal clause does not reach it and the wave gate cites the recorded corpus run instead.
